jobs_results.title: Project Manager Electronic Payment Methods
jobs_results.description:
The future is our choice

At Atos, as the global leader in secure and decarbonized digital, our purpose is to help design the future of the information space. Together we bring the diversity of our people’s skills and backgrounds to make the right choices with our clients, for our company and for our own futures.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Project Manager to lead our Electronic Payment Methods team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electronic payments, including familiarity with various payment platforms, technologies, and regulatory requirements. As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of electronic payment solutions to meet the needs of our organization and our customers.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage the Electronic Payment Methods team, including project planning, resource allocation, and performance management.
• Develop and implement strategic plans for... electronic payment initiatives, in alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, engineering, finance, and compliance, to define requirements and deliver solutions on time and within budget.
• Identify and mitigate risks associated with electronic payment projects, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and best practices.
• Monitor and evaluate the performance of electronic payment systems, analyzing data and metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Stay current with industry trends and developments in electronic payments, incorporating new technologies and innovations into our payment ecosystem.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on electronic payment methods, providing guidance and support to internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the Electronic Payment Methods team.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, with a focus on electronic payments or financial technology.
• Proven track record of successfully leading complex projects from conception to implementation, preferably in the electronic payments industry.
• Strong understanding of electronic payment technologies, including but not limited to EMV, NFC, QR codes, mobile wallets, and blockchain.
• Familiarity with regulatory requirements and compliance standards related to electronic payments, such as PCI DSS and PSD2.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
• PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification is a plus.
• Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies is desirable.

Teleworking: Initially 100% in-person the first months and then hybrid modality.

After 3 months, the candidate would become part of the Workplace client's staff.

Work Address: Barcelona

Working time: 8-hour shift adapted to the client in the Banking Sector

If you are passionate about electronic payments and possess the skills and experience required for this role, we encourage you to apply and join our dynamic team!

How to Apply: Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant experience to gergana.panicharova@atos.net

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.

Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.

Choose your future. Choose Atos

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Req ID: 120376

Remote Position: No

Region: Europe

Country: Spain

State/Province: La Pobla De Vallbona

City: Valencia

Summary

The Project Manager (Lead Engineer, Program/Project Management) is accountable for planning and directing design engineers and other technical engineers working on specific projects. They manage the development, implementation, and evaluation of complex designs. They are responsible for managing large projects with complex scope, multiple streams of work and inter-dependencies

Detailed Description

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
• Manage two or more projects of medium complexity (technology, organizationally). Lead cross-functional, global core team(s), kick off programs, establish schedules and drive meetings
• Present and communicate status to the business leaders and customers. Reviews and interprets customer documentation.
• Implement change as directed in the product lifecycle process and recommends process improvements
•... Plan the overall program and monitor the progress. Drive the creation, review, approval and update of the Program Plan/WBS including resources.
• Daily program management throughout the program life. You'll be the go-to person for everything involving a project's organization and timeline
• Drive the program core team to meet or exceed program objectives (Cost, Quality, Schedule, Features, Fulfillment/Continuity of Supply, Solution delivery across products & service offerings, Customer Specific Needs)
• Define the program governance (controls)
• Manage the program’s budget. Forecast actuals against plan/quote for income/revenue, cost/labour & expense
• Manage risks and issues, taking corrective measurements
• Provide leadership and technical recommendations to help move projects forward (incl. Escalation and reporting to Management team) --- particularly in time of impasse, ambiguity, or conflict
• Coordinate the projects and their interdependencies. Manage and utilize resources across projects
• Engage, collaborate and coordinate with customers and other Celestica teams across different geographies
• Align the deliverables (outputs) to the program’s “outcome” with the aid of the business change manager
• Manage and maintain the main program documentation, such as the Program Initiation document

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
• Project Management specific tools & methodologies (incl: Project plan creation, establish and distribute project roles, and communicate effectively what is needed in order to make the project successful. Risk management, Change management, Negotiation, Business case generation...)
• Strong interpersonal skills (leadership and communication)
• Effective written and verbal communication at all organizational levels and have the ability to rapidly establish a broad network
• Possess a positive, can-do attitude and a collaborative nature
• Fluent in Spanish and English - Proficiency in English at a high level is a must

Physical Demands
• Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
• Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
• Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
• Occasional travel may be required (up to 25%)

Typical Experience
• Minimum of 5 years experience leading product development or manufacturing projects.
• Candidates with experience in a technical or highly regulated industry (e.g., Healthtech or Manufacturing) will be given preference

Typical Education
• Bachelor / Master Degree Engineering
• PMP Certified is an advantage

Notes

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).

At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world’s best brands. Through our recognized customer-centric approach, we partner with leading companies in Aerospace and Defense, Communications, Enterprise, HealthTech, Industrial, Capital Equipment and Energy to deliver solutions for their most complex challenges. As a leader in design, manufacturing, hardware platform and supply chain solutions, Celestica brings global expertise and insight at every stage of product development – from drawing board to full-scale production and after-market services for products from advanced medical devices, to highly engineered aviation systems, to next-generation hardware platform solutions for the Cloud. Headquartered in Toronto, with talented teams spanning 40+ locations in 13 countries across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers.

Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services

jobs_results.title: Agile Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Location & work modality: Rubí / Barcelona Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

Start: ASAP

Type of Contract: Full Time / Permanent

About Submer

The best way to introduce you to Submer is undoubtedly through our values: Sustainable, Unique, Bold, Making Sense, Empathetic and Reliable. If these resonate with you we're sure you will find your place here in no time.

At Submer, we believe that our digital world can be more sustainable, more efficient and more environmentally friendly. Submer is solving the biggest problems of datacenter, supercomputer, hyperscale and edge applications to make that future possible.

Our multinational talented team has a huge passion in reducing IT environmental footprint and expertise in datacenter design and day-to-day operations. We’re scaling our team and operations worldwide to meet growing international demand.

What impact you will have

As an Agile Project Manager experienced Scrum Master adept at driving Agile methodologies and nurturing synergistic... collaboration within diverse, cross-functional teams. The role entails overseeing the development of two hardware products alongside a software team, ensuring seamless integration across both domains. Proficient in identifying and resolving impediments, the Scrum Master is instrumental in streamlining processes to enhance project delivery efficiency.

What you’ll do:
• Facilitate Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) ensuring active participation and adherence to the Scrum process.
• Practice servant leadership by empowering and supporting the Scrum Team to self-organize and achieve their goals while shielding them from external distractions and impediments.
• Identify and remove blockers hindering the team's progress, collaborating with stakeholders to resolve organizational issues impacting the team.
• Coach team members and the organization on agile principles and Scrum practices, promoting collaboration among team members, stakeholders, and other Scrum roles.
• Work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to ensure clear communication and alignment on project goals.
• Facilitate regular retrospectives to reflect on processes and identify opportunities for improvement, implementing new practices to enhance team efficiency.
• Assist the team in establishing and monitoring relevant metrics to track performance and progress, providing insights through metrics such as burndown charts and velocity.
• Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to gather project requirements, provide updates, and manage expectations, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and stakeholders.
• Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and status updates, and generate regular progress reports for stakeholders and leadership.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree in Business administration, Project Management, or a related field such as Engineering (master’s preferred).
• Proven experience as a Scrum Master in hardware product development (minimum 5 years).
• Proficiency in Jira.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
• Outstanding organizational and multitasking capabilities.
• Native English is required, and good working knowledge of Spanish is preferred (other languages are a plus).
• Proactive self-starter with clear internal and external communication skills.
• Strong critical thinking skills.

What we offer
• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
• Restaurant Pass.
• Private Health Insurance.
• A healthy work environment with fresh fruits to energise and an on-site gym for active breaks.
• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
• You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our Inclusive Responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law

jobs_results.title: Project Manager | BPM | 100% remote
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Job Description

We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer company with over 29.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 30 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies. **

What are we looking for?**

We’re looking for a Project Manager who will be responsible for providing administrative, operational, and coordination assistance to the teams. The perfect candidate should have at least 5 years of working experience. This is a full remote position and for one of our most important clients of the banking sector in an international project. **

Key Responsibilities**
• Documentation Management
• Data Tracking and Reporting
• Administrative Support
• Resource Coordination
•... Financial Tracking
• Tool and Software Management
• Communication Facilitation
• Issue and Risk Tracking
• Process Adherence
• Meeting Coordination
• Training and Onboarding
• Quality Assurance
• Working with other IT Leads (SDS and BPM) and architects to ensuring technical solutions are aligned to Architecture strategy
• Ensuring BPM Squads are aligned to Product priorities
• Ensuring Technical, Solution, Security and Data Architecture approvals with support from E2E IT team if/when required.
• Providing release estimation based on current requirements and velocity of the team, calculate the targeted Go Live date alongside BPM Cross team

Mandatory Skills
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills to manage various tasks concurrently.
• Attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and documentation.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with team members and stakeholders.
• Basic understanding of project management concepts and methodologies.
• Problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to handling challenges.
• Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
• Time management skills to meet deadlines and prioritise tasks effectively
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
• Experienced in Appian deliveries and an expert in software engineering and cloud
• Strong understanding of Operations processes
• Proven experience in multiple aspects of Project Delivery/Management using Agile Frameworks
• Strong communication and organisation skills, at both technical and business level
• Ability to define design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release support in an agile development environment
• Experience at executing engineering and release priorities successfully through strong leadership and communication

Skill Desirable
• Financial Services industry experience
• Some Spanish knowledge

Valuable and desirable: being entitled of Disability Certificate (at least 33% score) **

What can we offer?**
• 23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!
• Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).
• `Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)
• Free access to several training platforms
• Professional stability and career plans
• UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.
• The option to pick between 12 or 14 payments along the year.
• Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)
• UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

If you would like to know more, don’t hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you in detail. We are waiting for you!

At Otis, we move billions of people every day!

How? Through our talented Team of more than 69,000 employees, who are passionate about what we do and what’s next.

From our foundation of excellent products (escalators, elevators and moving walkways), to our next chapter of digital transformation, this is a great time to join our Company!

As an IT PROJECT MANAGER (H/M), located in Madrid, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

Work with the Solution Architect and Business Analysts to understand and clarify business requirements.
• Conduct design reviews and validate estimations from internal and external resources
• Gain proficiency in OTIS development standards and ensure teams follow
• Working under the Process of Functional Module and work with the internal and external team to... provide the valid solution for the problem.
• Experience with designing, developing, and testing EnterpriseOne objects across Functional Modules
• Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle (Requirement gathering, Designing, Development & Testing, signing off with user, providing production support)
• Good problem solving and debugging skills.
• Analyze requirements, design, code, and test medium to complex solutions.
• Design effective, scalable, and maintainable solutions following OTIS development standards
• Troubleshoot existing applications and create long term solutions
• Provide accurate estimates for development effort and risks of proposed solutions

To be successful in this role you will have:
• Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
• Must be meticulous with a strong analytical background to perform preliminary functional user testing.
• Ability to achieve results in a dynamic and demanding environment
• Ability to communicate well to all levels of Key Users.
• Demonstrates the highest ethical standards

Experience Required
• 6 - 12 years overall IT/DT experience
• 6+ years of technical experience with .Net c#, developments, ASP.Net MVC, Net Core, WebAPI, Entity Framework.
• Good understanding HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, JQuery.
• 6+ years of MSQL Server.

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager, Solutions Delivery
jobs_results.description:
About Thunes

Thunes is a global, fast-growing, and innovative Fintech scale-up that uses technology to disrupt and transform the existing financial system.
We have a strong Mission: to create a better global payments network, and a great Purpose: to connect the world to economic opportunities and address systemic inequality when it comes to financial services.
We are proud to power payments for the world’s fastest-growing businesses and work with some of the amazing global brands - from Gig Economy giants such as Uber and Deliveroo and Southeast Asia's super-app Grab, to global Fintech leaders such as PayPal and Remitly.
Our Products help to drastically simplify the Payment integration experience for our customers: with a single, simple connection, businesses and consumers can send payments to – and get paid in – every corner of the world. Instantly.
Thunes is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in London, Barcelona, Paris, Beijing, Shanghai, Miami, Dubai, Nairobi... Manila, Hong Kong and San Francisco!

Context of the role

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to be an integral part of our Solutions Delivery Team.
As part of the Solution Delivery team, this role will bring you great opportunities to work on various projects, collaborating with a diverse range of partners and teams.
The Solution Delivery team is responsible for supporting the integration of partners within the Thunes Cross-Border Payment platform. Processing millions of transactions per month and interconnecting hundreds of partners from all around the world, Thunes is continuously growing its coverage and footprint in the industry. A career with Thunes provides invaluable experience in an exciting and rapidly expanding market and an opportunity to be part of a truly global company with various offices worldwide and a workforce that includes dozens of different nationalities.

Qualities you would find in our Payment Integration Team
• Strong Team Spirit - Ability to learn lots of things and happy to help and each other
• Empowerment - Initiatives to build tools and propose solutions that adds value to the business
• Ownership - End to end ownership of project management in continuous integration from concept to deployment

Responsibilities:

We’re looking for a highly driven, self-motivated, technically hands-on person who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company and for our partners.
In this role, you will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working with different types of partners you must remain agile and always adapt your process and mindset to the partner you are dealing with.

In this role you will.
• Proactively scope the technical solution required to address customer requirements, assesses customers’ met and unmet needs, and recommends solutions that optimize value for both the customer and Thunes.
• Coordinates closely with sales, sales support, and delivery teams to align solution design with customers’ business requirements
• Secure from customer technical resource commitments needed to ensure a deal’s “technical close.”
• Lead and drive the partner integration from the analysis phase though the integration design until go live and post-delivery monitoring
• Support existing partners that are already integrated to the platform with their daily challenges and expansion plans
• Provide solutions and contribute to proof of concepts outside of the box for some special projects
• Drive improvements for internal monitoring, reporting and operational tools and processes
• Provides training to the sales team in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills

To stand out you will:
• Be customer facing – you will have a close relationship with our partners and business development teams to expand our coverage and services
• Work closely with different internal teams to understand and support operational processes and new solutions
• Always keep a solution mindset and look for improvements that you can bring to the organization
• Work with an agile and expanding team, offering mentoring, training and possibly management to junior members
• Participate in continuous integration, managing updates from concept to deployment
• Opportunistically pursues additional business development opportunities within customer firms

Skills & Qualifications:
• Prior & proven min. ~3 years of experience in a technical project management (API / Integrations) or solutions delivery role with external stakeholders
• Experience in a B2B company supporting partners on a technical solution or service
• Experience working and strong interest in the Fintech and/or Payment Industry and market innovations
• Experience working and integrating with APIs over IP (REST, Json XML, Web Services, …)
• Experience working in an Agile environment – Jira management is a plus
• Demonstrate motivation to learn new skills and technologies
• Ability to work effectively, multi-task, agile and take responsibility in challenging situations
• Strong customer focused and result oriented mindset
• Independent and proactive - willing to get things done
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills, be creative, friendly and solution-oriented with customers and colleagues
• Fluency in English, other European or African languages are a plus.

Sound like you? Apply now

Our culture believes in Powering Your Potential. We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what #LifeAtCummins is all about.

Project Manager

Description

We are selecting a Project Manager for Cummins Spain, San Fernando de Henares.

Hybrid work model, travelling 60%, relocation is not eligible .

English high level (C1 Cambridge equivalent) is a MUST.

In this role, you will make an impact in some of the following ways:
• Identifying project stakeholders, risks, work scope, budget and schedule expectations
• Developing Project Plans
• Reporting to both internal and external stakeholders, including Company Leaders, the status of his/her projects: time schedule, costs vs. Budget, risks, technical issues... etc
• Coordinating with subject matter experts to ensure that the project execution plan has correctly identified the required resources, tools, and methodology.
• Understanding project activities and interdependencies in order to support the development of an accurate budget and schedule, then managing project execution accordingly.
• Understanding contractual terms and conditions
• Serving as the primary client interface
• Supporting the establishment of effective working relationships, both within the project team and between the project team and external stakeholders. Measuring project performance, forecasting outcomes and, when necessary, developing proactive course corrections
• Ensuring that the project team is adhering to applicable Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) and Quality Management, and Projects Systems
• From the sales process, identifying and register the Projects’ risks, monitoring these risks while using creativity and out-of-the-box thinking to propose mitigation

To be successful in this role you will need the following:
• Engineering College, University, or equivalent degree required
• Electrical or Mechanical background preferably
• Relevant work experience in Engineering Project Management (2 to 4 years minimum)
• Very high level of Spanish & English language : written and oral communications (minimum level C1 equivalent)
• Main skills/competences: Excellent Communication skills, Team oriented, Solution driven.
• Availability to travel (60%)
